mapper.insert: insert into ai_agent_status_log (agent_id, user_id, event_type, from_status, to_status, from_call_status, to_call_status, record_id, log_time, create_time) values (#{agentId}, #{userId}, #{eventType}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{fromCallStatus}, #{toCallStatus}, #{recordId}, #{logTime}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select log_id, agent_id, user_id, event_type, from_status, to_status, from_call_status, to_call_status, duration, record_id, log_time, create_time from ai_agent_status_log where agent_id = #{agentId} order by log_time desc, log_id desc limit 1

select to_status as toStatus, to_call_status as toCallStatus, coalesce(sum(case when duration is null then 0 else duration end), 0) as durationSum, count(1) as eventCount from ai_agent_status_log where log_time >= #{beginTime} and log_time <= #{endTime} group by to_status, to_call_status
